briefing.headline: Nvidia and AI chip stocks fell sharply on Tuesday, though the wider market recovered most of its early losses.

points.text: Nvidia shares fell almost 6% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped nearly 8%, while the Dow rose 0.86%.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia's board voted to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO. Governance experts and a former congressional investigator criticised the move as a mistake or a risk.
points.label: reported

points.text: New US tariff proposals on 14 trading partners, including China and the EU, were announced. Investors also worried about hotter inflation and higher-rate risks.
points.label: reported

points.text: Goldman Sachs warns AI stocks have not bottomed. It says US household equity exposure now exceeds the dot-com bubble era.
points.label: opinion

points.text: Nvidia is heading for its first 'death cross' since March 2025, a sign of a long slide in its share price.
points.label: reported
